promptText:
Create a NEW illustration in exactly the same illustrated-set style as the reference image (a Korean scholar's-room object set: LOW-POLY FACETED planes — every surface is broken into flat angular colour facets like folded paper, NO drawn outlines, matte finish, subtle hanji paper grain visible inside the facets, warm walnut wood with dark lacquer and small muted dancheong accents), but with this subject instead:

a traditional Korean hanging scroll (족자) shown fully unrolled and seen straight from the front, flat against the picture plane, filling the tall frame from top to bottom. From top to bottom it has: a dark lacquered wooden roller bar across the top with an octagonal gold end cap sticking out past each side; a narrow band of pale ivory silk mounting; a large EMPTY sheet of warm ivory hanji paper taking up the middle two thirds, with visible paper fibre texture and NOTHING drawn or written on it; a wider band of the same ivory silk mounting below it; and a second identical dark lacquered roller bar with octagonal gold end caps across the bottom. The paper panel must be completely blank and evenly lit.

Do not redraw the object that appears in the reference image; the reference is for style, palette and lighting only.

CAMERA AND LIGHT: exactly one object, seen FLAT AND STRAIGHT FROM THE FRONT with no perspective and no tilt, as if pinned flat against the picture plane; soft light from the upper left; gentle self-shading on the facets only; NO cast shadow, NO shadow on the ground, NO floor, NO wall, NO room, NO horizon line.

COMPOSITION RULES: the object is centred in the frame with an even margin of clear green on every side; it is a complete, self-contained cutout with crisp edges; nothing is cropped by the frame; one object only, no variants, no extra props.

BACKGROUND: flat pure #00FF00 chroma-key green everywhere outside the object, no gradient, no vignette, no shadow on the green.

IMPORTANT COLOR: keep exactly the reference palette — wood #A2663A #8F5130 #844A2D with facet shadows #633720 #5A3623 #3B271B, dark lacquer #2C221D #211914, aged hanji ivory #DBBC8D #C6AE8B, dancheong gold #BD924C, deep muted teal #274A3F, dark brick red #6A2316, stone grey #8B8478. Do NOT brighten, do NOT desaturate, do NOT use bright teal or bright red; matte only, no gloss.

ABSOLUTELY AVOID: black or dark outlines, line art, watercolour wash, soft painterly blending, gradients inside a facet, cast shadow, drop shadow, ground plane, room interior, white canvas, cute style, glossy 3D render, photorealism, sepia, people, hands, animals, readable text, letters, digits, hangul or hanja on any surface, extra objects, multiple variants of the object.

IMPORTANT: match the geometric faceted style, color palette, paper grain texture, and overall mood of the attached reference image exactly. This must look like part of the same illustrated set.

SUBJECT GUARDS (reject the output if any fail):
- the hanji paper panel is COMPLETELY EMPTY — no calligraphy, no painting, no seal, no border pattern, no watermark, no smudge inside the paper area
- shown FLAT and FRONTAL, not in three-quarter view and not rolled up — this scroll hangs on a wall, it is not the rolled prop in the reference
- exactly two roller bars (top and bottom), each with one octagonal gold end cap on the left and one on the right, the caps overhanging the paper width
- the scroll is straight and rectangular — no curling corners, no waving silk, no perspective tilt
- no hanger cord, no tassels, no wall, no hook
